subject: Pre-training bias mitigation
significance: This highlights the critical limitation of front-loaded bias mitigation strategies, arguing that the dynamic and emergent nature of societal biases necessitates continuous intervention across the entire AI lifecycle.

subject: Societal biases
significance: This establishes the fundamental characteristic of biases as non-static, evolving phenomena that can manifest unpredictably, challenging the efficacy of one-time or early-stage detection and correction.

subject: Bias manifestation
significance: This emphasizes the temporal distribution of bias emergence, underscoring the need for adaptive and continuous mitigation frameworks that account for new biases arising post-initial training.
